info.name: University of St Andrews Service Status Components API

params.name: filter[parent_id_null]
params.description: When true, retrieve only top-level components (those with no parent).

params.name: filter[parent_id_eq]
params.description: Retrieve the child components of the component with this ID.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of system components. Supports filtering by parent so that top-level components or the children of a given component can be retrieved.
